$comment: The three cancel entrypoints of 1inch Limit Order Protocol v4, copied from contracts/interfaces/IOrderMixin.sol (OrderMixin.sol implements them). `MakerTraits` is `type MakerTraits is uint256`, so its ABI word is uint256. Selectors: cancelOrder 0xb68fb020, cancelOrders 0x89e7c650, bitsInvalidateForOrder 0x05b1ea03. The deployed LOP (0x111111125421cA6dc452d289314280a0f8842A65 on every chain this tool serves) answers these.

functions.name: cancelOrder
functions.effect: bit invalidator: massInvalidate(nonceOrEpoch, 0) — spends the (maker, nonce) bit; remaining invalidator: marks the hash fully filled

functions.name: cancelOrders
functions.effect: cancelOrder for each pair; reverts MismatchArraysLengths when the arrays differ in length

functions.name: bitsInvalidateForOrder
functions.effect: bit invalidator only (reverts OrderIsNotSuitableForMassInvalidation otherwise): word[nonce >> 8] |= (1 << (nonce & 0xff)) | additionalMask; emits BitInvalidatorUpdated(maker, nonce >> 8, word)
